title: Use the final webhook destination URL

Confirm the redirect’s final URL belongs to the intended integration before changing the endpoint destination.
Use the verified final URL directly and confirm a fresh sandbox delivery succeeds.

title: Free up local space before retrying sync

section: Your disk space is low or your storage is almost full
passage: You must have enough local storage to sync files via Drive for desktop.

steps: Check free space on the local drive named in the error.
Free space through your normal storage cleanup process, or unpin files that no longer need offline access.
Quit and restart Drive for desktop, then verify that the affected upload resumes.
